title: Otori Emu — An Irreplaceable Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've gotta do what I can too...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Tomorrow, we'll be meeting with Riley Entertainment to finalize a licensing agreement that will allow us to use their characters.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As I'm sure you're already aware, Riley Entertainment produces and distributes films, some of which have become blockbusters that spawned a variety of popular characters.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland will have themes centering around these characters from now on.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We're out of choices.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've seen other rides get taken down or renovated to be all new but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If that partnership actually goes through, this won't be grandpa's Phoenix Wonderland anymore!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Phoenix Wonderland's a place where everyone from kids to the elderly all get to smile...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you know about this too, Mr. Mascot?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: No. This is my first time hearing this as well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's today too, right? When Riley Entertainment is supposed to come...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. That appears to be the plan...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Before they get here, I need to talk to Keisuke and Shosuke one last time.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: B-But what about practicing for your show...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll just have to say that I can't make it. Then I can go and talk to my brothers.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Please, Mr. Mascot. Will you find where they are for me?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Understood. I shall start searching...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Phoenix Woderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If I wait here, I'll be able to talk to them?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. They are preparing for when the park closes and their guests arrive so that they can show them around...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Until then, they each appear to be busy with other meetings and business matters.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: For you to see them together, waiting for them to greet their guests seems to be the only opportunity you will receive given the circumstances...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it! Thank you so much, Mr. Mascot!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: You're welcome... But you have some time until the park closes, so what would you like to do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go on a little walk...
Dreamland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (After wandering for a while, I ended up here...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And we'll need to decide soon which attraction to scrap next.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Trampoline Dome seems like a viable candidate. It's a low-yield attraction that's only meant for children so...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Ready...! Jump!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: And... Jump!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Those voices... They're coming from the Trampoline Dome.)

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: It's almost time to go home, you two...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: No! I wanna play on the trampoline some more!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Alright, alright. Just a little longer then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: C-Could they be siblings...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and Saki played here when they were kids too.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Keisuke and Shosuke said that kids stop coming here when they grow up but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If one of their precious memories just vanishes... That would be way too sad...)

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: Thank you for visiting Phoenix Wonderland. The park will be closing shortly.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Alright, you two. They're saying we have to go now.

rows.Speaker: Boy & Girl
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Hahaha. If you like this place so much, we can come again.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Then...! Can we come play on the trampoline again?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Of course. It'll always be waiting for you here.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Really?! Then let's come again tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line:
Well, tomorrow might be tough...
But we'll definitely come again.

rows.Speaker: Boy & Girl
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu, is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Saki isn't the only one that really truly loves this place...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah. My brothers and I just don't know that there could actually be a ton of people that really care...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I don't want just new visitors to come. I want everyone that's been here before to smile too!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means I have to stop them!
